changelog:
• No more duplicate orders: if the connection drops while you create an order and you tap Create again, you get the same order back
• Smoother, faster lists: orders and products scroll with less work, and product pictures are cached on the phone
• If a screen fails it now shows a retry screen instead of closing the app
• Phone numbers are matched however they are typed (017…, +88017…, 88017…), so a returning customer is found instead of added twice
• Returned orders now have their own status (and filter), separate from cancelled ones
• Confirm a returned parcel from the order screen: put it back in stock, or mark it damaged
